repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The IR requires a 30-second sustain window (300 ticks at 100ms). The candidate uses a 1000ms wrapper period and a threshold of 30, causing the action to fire at 29 seconds (29 ticks * 1000ms) instead of 30 seconds. Additionally, the 1000ms wrapper cannot observe the condition dropping and recovering between iterations, violating the sustain requirement.
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed period to 100ms to match the sustain grid. Updated the threshold from 30 to 301 (300 ticks + 1) so the action fires exactly at the 30-second mark (tick 301), ensuring the condition was held for the full 30 seconds.
